# Frozen benchmark v5

Created before stage 06 production edits from commit
`d655cea1fe79177ce8d13ce66adce01ab02076c4` with generator `1.4-stage5`.
The working tree included unrelated user changes; the manifest records actual source hashes.

`benchmark-v5.zip` SHA256:
`27a24f28b7f7564f3f6e0ee1da275a4fd28317ede2b4973ad8bd4ae4e3671dc9`.

The archive retains a 33 x 33 H6 sequence with three observations, circular
screen, vertical occluder, drift, frame clipping, references, and instance masks.
The complete input configuration and provenance are inside the archive.
The current reader must accept the historical bytes without regenerating them.

Run `python -X utf8 -m unittest trackleed.tests.test_synthetic_frozen -v`.
